title: Before You Leave
subtitle: Preparation
content: Carry a charged phone, photo ID, power bank, water, and any essential medications. Inform a trusted person where you are going.

title: What to Bring
subtitle: Essentials
content: Water, snacks, first aid supplies, face mask if needed, emergency contact numbers, and weather-appropriate clothing.

title: Stay Safe
subtitle: During the Protest
content: Stay with your group, remain aware of exits, avoid escalating confrontations, and document incidents only when it is safe to do so.

title: If Detained
subtitle: Know Your Rights
content: Stay calm. Ask why you are being detained. Request access to a lawyer and inform a trusted contact as soon as possible. Refer to the first Know Your Rights tab on the home page for more information.
